blindReview.reason: Apple core is literal; core is the figurative heart of a matter.

clues.wordAConnection: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.

blindReview.reason: An apple a day keeps the doctor away; heart doctor is an everyday phrase.

blindReview.reason: Honey is the sweet thing; apples are sweet but so is every fruit, so it does not point.

provenance.authorReason: HONEY only; apple blossoms are a hop

Apple core is direct; honey has nothing.

pairs.pairNote: SKELETON is an excellent hint; the other two are key-first.

pairs.pairNote: CLEAR and DRINK both land; HALF is a nice idea that leans glass.
